runtime.dataset_export: provider-neutral deterministic exporter with strict_verified_only, accepted_verified, and all_with_status policies
runtime.benchmarks: versioned synthetic ground truth, category metrics, tiny-text stage evaluation, baseline comparison, JSON/Markdown reports, and configurable quality gates
runtime.job_api: bounded asynchronous FastAPI submission, polling, local durable metadata, idempotency, page-image access, authenticated deletion, and policy-aware exports
runtime.runtime_lifecycle: validated auto/cpu/cuda selection, lazy/startup model lifecycle contracts, safe capability reporting, and bounded GPU/page concurrency
runtime.observability: bounded content-free metrics, optional OpenTelemetry-compatible spans, capability-aware readiness, and stage latency/failure instrumentation
runtime.recovery_profiling: page failure isolation, completed-page checkpoints, completed_with_warnings, and DPI/time/memory/artifact profiling

database.storage: local immutable artifact adapter plus atomic local job/document metadata

implementation_program.truthfulness_note: No OCR accuracy or handwriting-quality claim is made without permitted ground truth and installed model runtimes.

known_non_blocking_issues: The default Pillow layout detector is conservative; handwriting/formula/form/table-cell semantics require a deployed model adapter.
HTR and table-cell adapters are intentionally unavailable by default until production model runtimes, weights, licensing, and benchmark labels are supplied.
Tesseract printed OCR is a real adapter, but Persian traineddata and recognition quality require deployment smoke tests and labeled benchmarks.

Gateway rate limiting, secret-manager rotation, shared durable storage adapters, distributed queue/restart recovery, load testing, backup restore verification, and advisory scanning require target infrastructure.
The local in-process worker persists page checkpoints but does not reclaim queued jobs after process restart; use a shared queue/worker adapter before multi-instance public deployment.
Docker build/smoke, GPU/model runtime smoke, load testing, advisory scanning, distributed infrastructure smoke, and external deployment were not performed in the current environment.
